extName.message: VR.AR — Does it work on my headset?

extDesc.message: Tells you whether a VR game works on your headset, on Steam, PlayStation and any other page that mentions it.

popupWhat.message: Tells you whether a VR game works on your headset, on Steam, PlayStation and any other page that mentions it.

storeSupportedInfo.message: Open a game's page and the card shows up on its own.

scanningPage.message: Looking for games on this page

scanningPageInfo.message: If it mentions a game from the catalogue, the card appears at the bottom right.

notAvailableInfo.message: It only works on Steam and PlayStation. You can turn it on below for the rest of the web.

grantTitle.message: Make it work across the web

grantBody.message: Right now it works on Steam and PlayStation. Turn this on and it will also tell you on blogs, articles and reviews that mention a VR game.

approxCaveat.message: Approximate match. If this is a different edition or a similarly named game, the answer may not apply.

detectedBecause.message: Detected because this page mentions the game.

verdictPcInfo.message: Requires a PC able to run VR

verdictPcInfoPsvr2.message: Requires a PC and the official PS VR2 adapter

verdictUnknownInfo.message: We haven't verified this game on this model yet.

verdictNoInfoNone.message: It isn't on any platform your headset supports

optAutoHint.message: If you turn this off, the extension won't appear on any page.

optMutedHint.message: Sites where you chose to hide the card.
